indicator_definition: Economic losses from weather and climate-related extreme events as a percentage of GDP. Includes floods, storms, droughts and heatwaves. Data compiled from civil protection databases and reinsurance sources.
rationale: Climate change increases extreme weather events and economic losses. Progress means limiting economic losses from climate-related events through adaptation and mitigation.
methodology_characteristics: Data compiled from national reports, CATDAT database and reinsurance sources. Covers insured and uninsured losses from weather-related events. Published periodically by Eurostat and the EEA.
